parts.label: f
parts.text:
Suggest two ways for Holly to transfer the poster image to the printer. (2 marks)
[--Answer:
(a) Bitmap image. The poster includes real-life images, which can hardly be represented by vector images.
(b) Colour depth and resolution.
(c) She can add a QR code that represents the URL of the registration form.
(d) PNG: It uses lossless compression, which preserves the quality of an image.
JPG: It has a smaller file size.
(e) Dot density and supported colour.(f) She can use a USB flash drive to import the poster to the printer. She can connect the printer to the computer through a USB cable and then send the file to the printer.
--]
